verdict.rationale: AngelList's own docs say many cap table reports can be exported to Excel and that it offers an Open Cap Table Format (OCF) export of the cap table, giving the ops user an open, portable copy of ownership data. Its support for moving customers to other providers such as J.P. Morgan and Pulley further suggests the data is not locked in. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the full transaction history or ledger can be exported, explicit CSV support, confirmation that exports are available on all plans at any time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
